engine_bound_statement: In 9 of 10 years the book was stopped by OUR settlement engine and not by the market or the company's balance sheet (2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025). Those years understate what this supplier would have won, and the flat curve there is an artefact of the simulation rather than a commercial result.
win_rate_statement: From 2018 onward the conversion rate the company planned on was computed over a history our own settlement engine had already bound, so it falls without any commercial mechanism suppressing it. Read the decline as an artefact of this simulation, not as a supplier losing its touch -- and note the quote budget, and therefore the acquisition spend, is derived from that same rate.
